project_name: DEADZONE — Westfall Character Skins & Weapon Pose Update
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Minimalism & Military Precision)
summary: Concise incremental design blueprint adding 6 selectable character skins (Asker, FBI, Sivil, Terörist, Çete Erkek, Çete Kadın), real-time 3D character preview with idle weapon holding and firing poses based on reference images, 9-weapon loadout synchronization, mobile 390px support, and seamless multiplayer integration while strictly preserving the established DEADZONE visual language.

idle_pose_breakdown.character_posture: Low-ready tactical shoulder or chest hold. Torso rotated slightly 12-15 degrees off-axis. Elbows tucked close to ribs. Left support hand cradling gun handguard/grip; right dominant hand on trigger assembly at chest/hip level. Muzzle depressed 20-30 degrees downward. Subtle cyclic breathing sway (0.012 vertical sine wave, 1.8s loop).
idle_pose_breakdown.visual_tension: Vigilant, relaxed combat ready. Weapon held safely yet immediately ready to snap into line of sight.

fire_pose_breakdown.character_posture: Raised sightline combat firing stance. Both arms extended straight toward crosshair target line, rifle stock firmly wedged into right shoulder pocket. Left forearm locked beneath the barrel/shroud for vertical recoil mitigation. Head slightly cocked down towards iron sights/optics. High-energy muzzle flash illumination, intermittent barrel flash particle burst, and dynamic kickback recoil along Z-axis (-0.08m to -0.12m with exponential damping).
fire_pose_breakdown.visual_tension: Kinetic muzzle discharge, explosive recoil impulse, intense tactical focus, shell casing ejection angle.

visual_identity.features: Kevlar PASGT kask, taktik askeri balistik hücum yeleği, şarjör cepleri, omuz birim arması, kamuflaj askeri pantolon ve çöl botları.
Lacivert/gece siyahı taktik rüzgarlık, sarı 'FBI' göğüs/sırt harfli taktik plaka taşıyıcı yelek, kulaklık telsiz aparatı, koyu operasyon şapkası veya kaskı.
Kapüşonlu yıpranmış pamuklu ceket veya oduncu gömleği, kot pantolon, bere veya dağınık saç, basit göğüs askısı ve sırt çantası.
Yüzü saran koyu kırmızı/zeytin yeşili poşu (kufiye/balaklava), çapraz mühimmat kemeri (bandolier), haki kargo pantolon, deri eldivenler.
Siyah deri ceket veya bomber mont, kollarda dövme dokusu, gümüş boyun zinciri, ters takılmış beyzbol şapkası, siyah kargo pantolon.
Koyu bordo/biker deri yelek veya dar taktik üst, yüksek kesim operasyon botları, hafif kadınsı model silüeti (dar bel/kalça orantısı), at kuyruğu veya örgülü saç detayı.

skin_coloring_and_accessories.soldier: Kevlar helmet (SphereGeometry cut), plate carrier chest box with 3 ammo pouches, green/khaki camo tints (#4a5944 shirt, #2c382b pants, #334132 vest).
skin_coloring_and_accessories.fbi: Dark navy tactical windbreaker (#171c26), high-contrast 'FBI' badge on chest, tactical vest, dark baseball cap/tactical lid.
skin_coloring_and_accessories.civilian: Brown flannel / hoodie torso (#6e4d3b), blue jeans (#3f4651), visible hair mesh instead of helmet, survival rucksack on back.
skin_coloring_and_accessories.terrorist: Shemagh / kufiye wrapped head (Cylinder/Torus geometry covering lower face), dark green/sand camo clothing, diagonal bandolier ammo strip.
skin_coloring_and_accessories.gang_male: Black leather jacket (#1c1c1e), gold/silver chain torus neck ring, reversed snapback cap, tattooed arm texture or dark sleeves.
skin_coloring_and_accessories.gang_female: Bordeaux tactical vest (#47212b), slender torso scaling (scale x: 0.88, z: 0.85), sleek hair mesh ponytail (CapsuleGeometry extended backward).

animation_human_enhancement.function_signature: animateHuman(g, time, moving, running, dt, direction, poseMode = 'idle', firing = false)
animation_human_enhancement.idle_pose_logic: Arms rotated downward: left arm arm.rotation.x = -0.75, right arm arm.rotation.x = -0.85. Gun rested at chest height: gunRest.set(0.20, 1.25, 0.45). Gentle breathing oscillation: Math.sin(time * 2.2) * 0.008.
animation_human_enhancement.fire_pose_logic: Both arms raised straight ahead: arm.rotation.x = -1.52, arm.rotation.y = 0.12. Gun pushed forward at eye level: gunRest.set(0.18, 1.48, 0.65). Cyclic firing recoil pulse: if firing, kickback gun.position.z -= 0.12 * Math.sin((time % 0.15) / 0.15 * Math.PI) with randomized muzzle flash mesh opacity.

join_request_payload.name: string (2-18 chars)
join_request_payload.weapon: string (one of 9 weapons: ak47, ak117, ak107, shotgun, m4, rocket, minigun, flamethrower, lava)
join_request_payload.skin: string (one of 6 skins: soldier, fbi, civilian, terrorist, gang_male, gang_female - defaults to 'soldier')

websocket_sync.player_broadcast: Include 'skin' field in state.players JSON snapshot so all connected clients instantiate the exact corresponding 3D skin model and materials.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT alter or delete existing DEADZONE core mechanics (movement, bullet physics, sound system, audio preloading, leaderboards, settings).
Preserve all existing CSS classes in /app/frontend/src/App.css. Add additive CSS rules under .skin-grid, .skin-card, and .pose-segmented controls.
Add the 'skin' parameter to backend/server.py JoinRequest model (optional with default='soldier' for backwards compatibility).
Keep localStorage key 'deadzone-skin' to persist user selection across reloads.
Verify mobile responsiveness at exactly 390px width: ensure no horizontal overflow, buttons remain minimum 44px tap target height.
